answer_2.quote: We employ two metrics for evaluating WVS responses. The first is the Hard Alignment Metric, which measures plain accuracy... The second metric is the Soft Alignment Metric, a relaxed version... We also use Spearman's ρ-rank correlation coefficient for Hofstede dimensions.

answer_3.quote: For the unconstrained settings... we use GPT-4o to analyze these responses and determine the model's stance... We additionally annotate 100 unconstrained responses using Claude Sonnet 3.7, an independent model...
methods: LLM-based mapping of free-form responses to survey options

answer_4.quote: The first two authors manually reviewed a random sample of 100 forced open-ended and 100 fully unconstrained responses... We adopt a blinding protocol in which reviewers are unaware of the source of the response... Any discrepancies are resolved through consensus.
answer_4.guideline: Human reviewers compare LLM-generated open-ended responses to survey answer choices, assigning the most appropriate option or marking as unclassifiable.
criteria: correctness of mapping to survey option
